# Unary negation: dst[i] = -src[i] uses Neg.

# The scalar program is the reference behavior.
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

# The simd build must behave identically.
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func NegFloat32s(dst, src []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = -src[i]
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import (
	"simd"
	"unsafe"
)

func NegFloat32s(dst, src []float32) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, src) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = -src[i]
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = src[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(src[_i:])
				_v1.Neg().StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func _loopvecOverlap[T any](a, b []T) bool {
	if len(a) == 0 || len(b) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	aStart := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(a)))
	aEnd := aStart + uintptr(len(a))*unsafe.Sizeof(a[0])
	bStart := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(b)))
	bEnd := bStart + uintptr(len(b))*unsafe.Sizeof(b[0])
	return aStart < bEnd && bStart < aEnd
}
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

func main() {
	dst := make([]float32, 4)
	src := []float32{1, -2, 3, -4}
	test.NegFloat32s(dst, src)
	fmt.Println(dst[0], dst[1], dst[2], dst[3])
}
-- testmain/output --
-1 2 -3 4
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 1 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- ops.go.guarded --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

func NegFloat32s(dst, src []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = -src[i]
	}
}
